image_description: A street-level view of a bakery storefront with a brick facade. The shop features a large display window filled with shelves of baked goods, illuminated by warm interior lighting. A blue sign with white text runs above the window. To the right is a glass door entrance, and to the left is a green utility box or lower cabinet structure. The scene has a slightly painterly or filtered aesthetic.
